## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the rotational component of a pose; a part of the pose.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the translational component ([`gmeow:hasPosePosition`](gmeow-hasPosePosition.md)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:hasPoseOrientation`](gmeow-hasPoseOrientation.md) at an [`Orientation`](../classes/gmeow-Orientation.md) carrying quaternion, Euler, or compass facets.
